logout.title: Sign out?
logout.body: Your scan history stays on this device.

login.rolesBody: Patients and clinics both see every number. The patient view adds plain-language guidance so results are clear without alarm; the clinic view adds clinical caveats and record fields.

scan.title: Scan a skin lesion
scan.intro: Take a clear, close, well-lit photo of a single spot. Fill the frame with the lesion and keep the camera steady. You can crop and fine-tune it next.
scan.tip1: Good, even lighting — avoid shadows and glare.
scan.tip2: Get close: the lesion should fill most of the frame.
scan.tip3: Keep it in focus; tap to focus on phones.
scan.tip4: Remove hair/marker lines from over the spot if you can.
scan.enhanceNote: Enhancement helps you and the clinician see the lesion clearly. The model analyses the image you send here.

camera.title: DARM Camera
camera.guidance: Fill the box with the spot • hold steady • tap to focus
camera.permissionNeeded:
Camera permission is needed to capture a lesion.
Enable it for DARM in your device Settings, then try again.
camera.noCamera: No camera found on this device.

result.title: Result
result.combinedMalignant: Combined chance of a cancerous / pre-cancerous type: {}%
result.allTypesTitle: How much it resembles each type
result.allTypesNote: Every class is shown — nothing is hidden. Percentages are the model’s estimated resemblance and add up to 100%.
result.askAssistant: Ask the DARM Assistant about this

chat.title: DARM Assistant
chat.offline: Assistant is offline (no API key set on the server).
chat.greetingGeneral: Hi! I'm the DARM Assistant. Ask me anything about skin lesions, your results, or how this app works. I'm not a doctor — for anything clinical, please see a dermatologist.
chat.greetingGrounded: Hi! I can explain your result: the model’s top match was {} ({}% resemblance). Ask me what it means, how sure it is, or what to do next.
chat.quickTypes: What do the 7 lesion types mean?
chat.quickPhoto: How should I take a good photo?
chat.historyEmpty: No saved conversations yet. Ask the assistant something and it will appear here.
chat.clearAllBody: This permanently removes every saved conversation on this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.translateMedicalNote: Uses the AI assistant to translate lesion explanations. The English original is always available.

disclaimer.short: Decision-support tool — not a medical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified clinician.
disclaimer.long: DARM is an AI screening aid trained on the HAM10000 dataset. It is NOT a medical device and has not been clinically validated. Its results can be wrong — in particular it correctly identifies only about 69% of true melanomas, so it must never be used to rule out skin cancer. Use it to help decide whether to see a dermatologist, not as a substitute for one.
disclaimer.reassurance: Take a breath. This is a screening estimate from a computer model, not a diagnosis. Whatever it shows, the sensible next step is calm and simple: if anything looks concerning, book a dermatologist. Most skin spots are harmless, and even the serious ones are usually very treatable when found early.
